errors.evidence: The error bars shown in the plot are horizontal, indicating uncertainty on the x-axis (Rank), not vertical, which would indicate uncertainty on the y-axis (Traces).

The description fails to mention that the size (spread) of the horizontal error bars varies between data points. The reference description notes that the spread is smallest at rank 16 and largest at rank 64.
The rate of increase is not steady; the line segment from rank 64 to 256 is visibly steeper than the segment from rank 16 to 64. Describing the increase as 'steady' oversimplifies the trend.
The description states that the error bars are vertical, but the image clearly shows horizontal error bars at each data point.
